d: Some of the world's rarest animals leave behind only fleeting sightings, scattered clues and stories that are difficult to verify. Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante ventures into remote forests, dangerous waters and unexplored caves in search of elusive species. From the mysterious Saola, also known as the Asian Unicorn, and the Dracula Monkey of Borneo to the Cape Lion, Fernandina tortoise, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Rocky Mountain Wolf and Rio Apaporis Caiman, each expedition presents a different challenge.
